div.div: حَصَصٌ Paucity, or scantiness, of the hair of the head; (S, K;) and of the fetlock of a horse: (TA:) also shortness of the beard, when its hair breaks off in pieces: (TA:) and the state of one suffering from a protracted disease, whose hair does not grow long. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
